messages:
Ravi (CSM): FYI Fluxlytics is expanding into two new products: live-summaries and vector-search for recommendations. Maya says pilot starts next Monday and they expect a 2.5-3x token/day bump.
Maya (Fluxlytics): Yes — current avg ~400k tokens/day. Target ~1.1M during pilot, then steady ~900k. Priority is stable p50/p95 and lower tail latency for search. Also want an eval on embedding recall after quantization.
Aaron (Solutions Eng): We can run a week-long Dedicated trial. Need recent request traces + session length CDF. Also what's their peak RPS and typical concurrency?
Maya (Fluxlytics): Peak RPS ~35, typical concurrency ~12. Uploading anonymized traces to the portal now.
Ivy (Infra): Early estimate: for peak with seq~768, recommend 1.5 nodes (round up to 2) with medium batching strategy. Suggest test config to try:
```
serve_config:
  batch_window_ms: 60
  max_batch_tokens: 4800
  eager_batch: false
runtime_tweaks:
  enable_kv_cache: true
  runtime_quant: fp16
```
Aaron (Solutions Eng): For embeddings we should test int8 quant and measure recall delta on their eval set. Also propose routing rules so embedding/search traffic goes to the Dedicated pool and generative to hosted until stable.
Sam (RevOps): Heads up on renewal: their contract renewal is in ~8 weeks. Maya hinted theyre evaluating price/commit options depending on Dedicated performance. I'll prepare options (small commit, month trial, discount tiers) and share.
Ravi (CSM): Let's put a small canary on Dedicated first 48h with real traffic replay. Aaron, can you own the canary plan?
Aaron (Solutions Eng): Yup. Plan: 48h replay at 20% of production token volume, collect p50/p95, tail latency, token/cost breakdown. Will include AB test for quantized vs fp16 embeddings.
Maya (Fluxlytics): Sounds good. Also want a checklist for compliance and log retention for private data—our legal team will review.
Ivy (Infra): I'll add retention defaults and KMS options to the ticket.
OpsBot: Ticket #CS-4834 opened: "Fluxlytics expansion pilot - Dedicated canary + embedding recall eval" Assigned: Aaron, Ivy. Due: 3 business days.
Ravi (CSM): Action items: 1) Aaron -> canary plan + test steps by Tue; 2) Ivy -> cost + ops checklist; 3) Sam -> renewal options draft; 4) Maya -> confirm eval dataset uploaded.
Maya (Fluxlytics): Eval dataset uploaded and scrubbed. ETA: traces + histogram in the portal.
Aaron (Solutions Eng): For smoke testing use this curl (replace token):
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"test"},{"role":"user","content":"<bulk test payload>"}],"max_tokens":200}'
```
Sam (RevOps): I'll coordinate finance review for the short promo and share a term sketch in this thread.
Ravi (CSM): Scheduling kickoff w/ Fluxlytics Wed 10am PT. Marking priority high. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
